title: E-means project claims k-means speedup with one-tenth epochs
summary: The E-means project page presents a k-means alternative for developers considering a replacement for Lloyd&\#x27;s algorithm, claiming it outperforms k-means while requiring one-tenth the epochs. The supplied material does not include an independent benchmark, so the headline speedup is a project assertion rather than a verified result; early commenters are testing whether it transfers to real workloads.
